title: Tulip with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='47' y='58' width='6' height='32' rx='3' fill='#3ccf4e'/>
  <!-- leaf left -->
  <path d='M48 75 Q30 68 28 52 Q40 54 48 68 Z' fill='#2fb344'/>
  <!-- leaf right -->
  <path d='M52 82 Q70 76 72 60 Q60 62 52 76 Z' fill='#5ee36a'/>
  <!-- tulip petals background -->
  <path d='M30 40 Q28 20 42 18 Q50 22 50 34 Q50 22 58 18 Q72 20 70 40 Q68 56 50 60 Q32 56 30 40 Z' fill='#ff5c8a'/>
  <!-- center petal -->
  <path d='M42 36 Q50 28 58 36 Q56 54 50 58 Q44 54 42 36 Z' fill='#ff8fb1'/>
  <!-- left petal highlight -->
  <path d='M32 38 Q32 24 42 22 Q44 32 42 44 Q36 46 32 38 Z' fill='#ffa5c0'/>
  <!-- right petal highlight -->
  <path d='M68 38 Q68 24 58 22 Q56 32 58 44 Q64 46 68 38 Z' fill='#ffa5c0'/>
  <!-- face area -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#ffd6e3'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='44' r='2.2' fill='#2b1b3a'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='44' r='2.2' fill='#2b1b3a'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='44.3' cy='43.3' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='54.3' cy='43.3' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 49 Q50 54 55 49' stroke='#2b1b3a' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='48' r='2.5' fill='#ff7aa2' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='48' r='2.5' fill='#ff7aa2' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- pot / soil -->
  <path d='M36 88 L64 88 L60 96 L40 96 Z' fill='#c96f3b'/>
  <rect x='34' y='84' width='32' height='6' rx='2' fill='#e08a4f'/>
</svg>
